The current rank-14 profile and bytecode inspection identify a distinct residual mechanism: a pure local bit-test branch followed by a shifting recurrence is admitted only by the generic typed-loop register interpreter, while the existing scalar-bitwise tier accepts no conditional branch and the existing control tier accepts only a counter-and-constant branch. This unit is selected only by bytecode shape, local-slot authority, numeric values, and a finite recurrence proof; it has no workload, source-path, checksum, or iteration-count admission. mechanism.summary: Add a guarded control-loop special plan for a side-effect-free local loop whose stable numeric input is bit-tested against a shifting local recurrence, conditionally increments a local numeric accumulator, and writes the recurrence before returning to the header.
mechanism.generality: The plan recognizes the compiler's ordinary local bytecode shape rather than JavaScript names or literals. It requires authoritative non-captured local writes, no direct eval or with environment, numeric input/accumulator/recurrence/limit values, a positive constant left-shift count, and a preflight proof that the same ToInt32 recurrence exits before it reaches a non-progressing state. Any accessor, closure-visible binding, coercion, non-number, unsupported jump/completion layout, unstable source, or unproven termination retains the existing typed-loop or interpreter path.
semantic_risks: preserving JavaScript ToInt32 and signed shift semantics, including NaN, infinities, signed zero, and shift-count masking
preserving postfix increment's numeric result and the compiler's block and loop completion slots while batching only unobservable authoritative local writes
never publishing partial native progress when a recurrence cannot be proven finite or a guard fails
keeping the existing ordinary execution path for captured locals, direct eval, with, global or property writes, and every non-matching control-flow shape

profile_evidence.shared_cost: The profile spends its largest exclusive cost in typed_loop::execute::run (1,235 top samples), entered from repeated direct-leaf calls. Exact bytecode is the pure sequence counter < limit; input & counter; conditional local postfix increment; counter << constant; backedge. The generic typed-loop program executes ten register operations per source iteration because no current special plan combines this branch with the shifting recurrence.
